lemma authorize_callback_binding:
  all-traces
  "∀ broker idp session_id code user #i.
    (Callback_Processed( broker, idp, session_id, code, user ) @ #i) ⇒
    (∃ state nonce #j.
      (Authorize_Started( broker, idp, session_id, state, nonce ) @ #j) ∧
      (#j < #i))"
/*
guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ broker idp session_id code user #i.
  (Callback_Processed( broker, idp, session_id, code, user ) @ #i)
 ∧
  ∀ state nonce #j.
   (Authorize_Started( broker, idp, session_id, state, nonce ) @ #j)
  ⇒
   ¬(#j < #i)"
*/
by sorry
